verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks with a `webhook-id` idempotency header, opt-in webhook signing, and a `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhook whose payload carries the screening result, so a system can react to outcomes without polling. Only the completion outcome is evidenced, not the full lifecycle the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented created/processing/requires-input lifecycle event types, signing verification details (algorithm, secret handling), a full event catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, verification lifecycle events arrive as signed webhooks — created, processing, verified, requires-input — so my system reacts to outcomes without polling

citations.quote: Every webhook we send carries a `webhook-id` header... Use it as your idempotency key.
Set up a webhook of type `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`
Webhook signing is opt-in per account.
